items: 【Pink Cordless Drill with LED】The 12V tool kits can be used for drilling home repairs, furniture assembly, or garden projects, its cordless design allows unrestricted movement. Equiped with built-in LED light, it can be used in a dark environment

【Rechargeable Battery】This pink drill is supplied with a type-C charging cable. You can connect it to a universal charger or USB output to charge the battery.The battery indicator light is next to the charge port, when the indicator is red, the battery is chargeing

【Empower Your DIY Skills】This Hand Tool Sets is made of alloy steel, chrome plated to prevent corrosion, grip is anti-skid and comfortable. Light, durable, strong, safe and compact tools are perfectly suitable for longer life. Four precision screwdrivers in pink tools are for smaller fasteners on home appliances and electronics, two full size screwdrivers and bit driver handle when only a manual touch is needed, it is also a good tool sets for women to do general DIY

【Ergonomic Design】 The 12V Cordless Drill Driver is lightweight and ergonomically designed for comfort during extended use. Its two-speed control allows for effortless switching between drilling and driving tasks. This thoughtful design minimizes fatigue and enhances control, making it suitable for both novice and experienced DIY enthusiasts

【Sturdy Storage Case】 Every essential tool is housed in a robust plastic case with molded compartments for each component, ensuring protection and easy access. Plus, the case is super portable and easy to stow, so you'll always have your tools on hand when you need them
